verdict.rationale: Pipecat is an open-source, self-hostable framework (pip-installable, runs locally or on your own infrastructure), which implicitly lets an operator choose where data/compute resides by choosing their own deployment location; however there is no explicit documentation of region/residency selection controls, especially for the hosted Pipecat Cloud offering. Missing for 10: explicit region-selection UI/API for Pipecat Cloud, data-residency compliance documentation (GDPR/SOC2 region guarantees), and confirmation that self-hosting is the only path to residency control.
